name: Residents Permit (Property Owners)

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be the owner of property in Montserrat and not a national of Montserrat.

evidence_required.document: Proof of property ownership in Montserrat
Fee: US$50 per applicant, plus any additional family members

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the source reviewed

sources.title: Government of Montserrat -- Online Immigration & Customs Portal: Residents Permit guide for property owners, fee (US$50 per applicant/family member), 24-hour processing

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Montserrat's initial build. This is a distinct, lighter-weight residence status tied purely to property ownership, sourced from the same official eVisa/immigration portal as ms_visitor_visa.json -- it is NOT the same as the Section 19 Permanent Residence Permit or Economic Residence Permit (see ms_permanent_residence.json and ms_economic_residence.json), which have separate, more demanding legal bases. Duration, renewal terms, and work/study rights are not addressed in the source reviewed; work_rights and study_rights are conservatively set to 'none' since nothing in the source suggests this status confers them, and a separate Work Permit (ms_work_permit.json) would still be required for employment. This route's precise legal relationship to Section 19's permits (whether it is a subsidiary category, an alias, or a genuinely separate mechanism) is not clarified by the source and is flagged as an open question.
